title: Which player has participated in the highest number of winning matches and
question: Which player has participated in the highest number of winning matches and which player has participated in the highest number of losing matches, considering only matches where they actually played (excluding null entries) and where their team won or lost (excluding draws)?

prediction.sql:
WITH slots AS (
  SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal,
         CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 'home' ELSE 'away' END AS side,
         p.pid AS player_api_id
  FROM Match m
  JOIN (
    SELECT id, home_player_1 AS pid FROM Match WHERE home_player_1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_2 FROM Match WHERE home_player_2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_3 FROM Match WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_4 FROM Match WHERE home_player_4 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_5 FROM Match WHERE home_player_5 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_6 FROM Match WHERE home_player_6 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_7 FROM Match WHERE home_player_7 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_8 FROM Match WHERE home_player_8 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_9 FROM Match WHERE home_player_9 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_10 FROM Match WHERE home_player_10 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_11 FROM Match WHERE home_player_11 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_1 FROM Match WHERE away_player_1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_2 FROM Match WHERE away_player_2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_3 FROM Match WHERE away_player_3 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_4 FROM Match WHERE away_player_4 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_5 FROM Match WHERE away_player_5 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_6 FROM Match WHERE away_player_6 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_7 FROM Match WHERE away_player_7 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_8 FROM Match WHERE away_player_8 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_9 FROM Match WHERE away_player_9 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_10 FROM Match WHERE away_player_10 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_11 FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
  ) p ON p.id = m.id
  WHERE m.home_team_goal <> m.away_team_goal
),
final AS (
  SELECT player_api_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN side='home' AND home_team_goal>away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       + SUM(CASE WHEN side='away' AND away_team_goal>home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
         SUM(CASE WHEN side='home' AND home_team_goal<away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       + SUM(CASE WHEN side='away' AND away_team_goal<home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
  FROM slots
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT (SELECT p.player_name FROM final f JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id=f.player_api_id ORDER BY f.wins DESC, f.player_api_id LIMIT 1) AS top_winner,
       (SELECT p.player_name FROM final f JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id=f.player_api_id ORDER BY f.losses DESC, f.player_api_id LIMIT 1) AS top_loser

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH player_matches AS (
  SELECT m.id AS match_id, p.player_api_id,
         CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 'W' ELSE 'L' END AS result
  FROM Match m
  JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  )
  WHERE m.home_team_goal <> m.away_team_goal
)
SELECT
  (SELECT p.player_name FROM player_matches pm JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pm.player_api_id
   WHERE pm.result='W' GROUP BY pm.player_api_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS winner,
  (SELECT p.player_name FROM player_matches pm JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pm.player_api_id
   WHERE pm.result='L' GROUP BY pm.player_api_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS loser
